grammar_focus: 现在完成时复习(主考:have/has + 过去分词 · since + 过去时间点/从句 · for + 一段时间 · up till now/so far 至今 · ever/just/already 位置 · have been to 去过 vs have gone to 去了没回)+ 定语从句 who/which/that/whose(辅考:指人/指物/所属,作主语不可省)
scene: 贾斯珀·怀特刚在城里买了新房,可自从搬进去,就老有人把车停在他家大门外,他自己的车一次都开不进车库;'禁止停车'的牌子毫无效果,于是他在门上装了一个丑陋的美杜莎石雕头像,盼着能把车和车主都变成石头——不过至今还没一个变成石头呢!

grammar_card.title: 说'到现在已经…'(现在完成时)
grammar_card.intro: 本课复习现在完成时——have/has + 过去分词,表示到现在为止已发生或完成的事。注意:since 接过去的时间点,for 接一段时间;up till now / so far 表'至今'。全用本课句子举例。

rows: He has just bought a new house.
I have not seen Tim since 1994.
for + 一段时间(持续多久)
Tim has been abroad for three years.
up till now / so far(至今为止)
Up till now he has won five prizes.

specialRules.rule: been to = 去过(回来了);gone to = 去了(还没回):I have been to New York.
定语从句:who/that 指人、which 指物、whose 表所属;作主语不能省:the people who believe…

prelisten.q: Listen and answer — What is Jasper White's problem?
options: People keep parking cars outside his gate
He has lost his house key
He can't find a parking sign

passage: Jasper White is one of those rare people who believes in ancient myths. He has just bought a new house in the city, but ever since he moved in, he has had trouble with cars and their owners. When he returns home at night, he always finds that someone has parked a car outside his gate. Because of this, he has not been able to get his own car into his garage even once. Jasper has put up 'No Parking' signs outside his gate, but these have not had any effect. Now he has put an ugly stone head over the gate. It is one of the ugliest faces I have ever seen. I asked him what it was and he told me that it was Medusa, the Gorgon. Jasper hopes that she will turn cars and their owners to stone. But none of them has been turned to stone yet!

since + 过去时间点/从句(自从…以来)
for + 一段时间(持续多久)
up till now / so far(至今为止)
have been to(去过)vs have gone to(去了没回)
定语从句 who / which(指人/指物,辅考)
定语从句 whose / whom(所属/作宾语,辅考)
